items.translation: 已配置的 SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor 实例。

items.source: In a typical auto-configured Spring Boot application this builder is available as a bean and can be injected whenever a SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor is needed.
items.translation: 在典型的自动配置的 Spring Boot 应用程序中，该构建器作为 Bean 可用，每当需要 SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor 时，都可以注入它。

items.source: Set whether to cancel remaining tasks on close. By default false not tracking active threads at all or just interrupting any remaining threads that still have not finished after the specified taskTerminationTimeout. Switch this to true for immediate interruption on close, either in combination with a subsequent termination timeout or without any waiting at all, depending on whether a taskTerminationTimeout has been specified as well.
items.translation: 设置是否在关闭时取消剩余任务。默认值为 `false`，即完全不跟踪活动线程，或者仅中断在指定taskTerminationTimeout之后仍未完成的任何剩余线程。将此选项切换为`true`以在关闭时立即中断，具体是结合随后的终止超时使用，还是完全不等待，取决于是否已指定了 `taskTerminationTimeout`。

items.source: Set the TaskDecorator to use or null to not use any.
items.translation: 将 TaskDecorator 设置为使用，或设置为 `null` 以不使用任何装饰器。

items.source: Build a new SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor instance and configure it using this builder.

items.source: Configure the provided SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor instance using this builder.

items.source: Set whether to reject tasks when the concurrency limit has been reached. By default false to block the caller until the submission can be accepted. Switch to true for immediate rejection instead.
items.translation: 设置是否在达到并发限制时拒绝任务。默认值为`false`，会阻塞调用者直到提交被接受。切换为`true`以立即拒绝。
